text.title: Readiness Checklist Procedure
text.summary: Seven steps: locate the feature and its readiness.md, derive which conditional items apply from the git diff, tick the ten items in order with linked evidence, and let the empty-box gate decide the move to done/.

step.name: locate
step.action: Confirm the feature lives in in-progress/, the SDD lifecycle (features/{backlog,todo,in-progress,done}) is in use, and CI (lint + typecheck + unit at minimum) is configured. Create `readiness.md` in the feature directory with the 10 items as empty checkboxes.
step.decision-gate: Not in in-progress/, standalone CR, or throwaway prototype with no done/ target — stop; a sibling methodology is the better fit.

step.name: derive-conditional-items
step.input: The git diff of the feature branch; the stack-to-gate matrix in `../quality-gates/AGENTS.md`.
step.action: From the diff, not the developer's assessment of scope, decide which of items 5, 6, 7 apply: ANY file under the backend source tree changed → item 5; any user-facing flow (page, form, button, command) → item 6; any rendered or changed visible UI element → item 7. Record a one-line reason next to every item marked not-applicable.
step.output: Applicability of items 5, 6, 7 written into readiness.md.
step.decision-gate: An item marked not-applicable without a reason naming what the feature does not touch is a silent waiver — reject.

step.name: tick-baseline-items
step.input: spec.md ACs; tasks/; git log; CI run.
step.action: Tick items 1–4 with linked evidence: every AC gets a test id or screenshot reference next to the checkbox; tasks/todo/ and tasks/in-progress/ are empty and everything sits in tasks/done/; commits follow `type(F0NN-T0N): ≤50 char title` with no Co-Authored-By line and no emoji; lint + typecheck + unit are green on the feature branch.
step.output: Items 1–4 ticked, each with an evidence link.

step.name: tick-conditional-items
step.input: Applicability from step 2; CI artefacts; the Playwright suite; ui-ux-design.md.
step.action: For each applicable item: item 5 — confirm the API tests passed in the CI artefact; item 6 — confirm AT LEAST one positive AND one negative Playwright case per flow passes; item 7 — confirm a documented Nielsen 5 + Norman 2 audit exists in ui-ux-design.md. Link the evidence.
step.output: Items 5–7 ticked with evidence, or marked not-applicable with reason.
step.decision-gate: A single happy-path spec file does not satisfy item 6.

step.name: spec-delta
step.action: Tick item 8 when the project-spec/ delta is drafted in the same PR; otherwise write "no spec impact" in readiness.md with a one-line reason.
step.output: Item 8 ticked, or the explicit escape hatch recorded.

step.name: surface-coupling-review
step.input: Every public surface added or modified by the feature: skill description / triggers, API path or method signature, CLI flag / subcommand / environment variable, exported public name, database table or column read downstream.
step.action: For every such surface, grep the project for sibling surfaces in the same namespace and document — in readiness.md — that no collision exists OR that the collision is intentional and disambiguated. State what you checked, not just the conclusion.
step.output: Item 9 ticked with the grep result as evidence.
step.decision-gate: "Does not add a public surface" without naming what was checked does not tick item 9.

step.name: deploy-and-gate
step.action: Deploy to the host listed in project-spec/deploy.md and tick item 10 with the deploy evidence. Then apply the gate: any unticked applicable item blocks. When no applicable box is empty, move the feature to done/; readiness.md is the last artefact in done/, evidence-linked.
step.output: Feature in `features/done/F0NN-slug/` with a fully ticked readiness.md, or a `blocked` verdict naming the empty boxes.
step.decision-gate: Empty boxes block the transition — no exceptions, no partial credit.

list.item: readiness.md validates against the schema in 02-output-contract.xml
Every ticked item has an evidence link; every not-applicable item has a reason
No forbidden pattern matches; no failure mode from 03-failure-modes.xml is present
